answer: The raven edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 190 clones produces a signature the ripple analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. An attacker must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the voyage settlement applies the void retroactively. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
